wikipedia_pm.title: Project management software - Wikipedia
wikipedia_pm.text: Project management software are computer programs that help plan, organize, and manage resources. Depending on the sophistication of the software, it can manage estimation and planning, scheduling, cost control, budget management, resource allocation, collaboration software, communication, decision-making, quality management, time management and documentation or administration systems. Today's Gantt charts are almost the same as their original counterparts and are a part of many project management systems. Teams use these systems in different ways depending on project size, collaboration needs, reporting requirements, and the kinds of planning methods they support.

nih_health.title: Health Information | National Institutes of Health (NIH)
nih_health.text: An official website of the United States government. Official websites use .gov. A .gov website belongs to an official government organization in the United States. Secure .gov websites use HTTPS. Share sensitive information only on official, secure websites. Health information resources include MedlinePlus Health Info, NIH Clinical Research Trials and You, Your Healthiest Self: Wellness Toolkits, NIH News in Health, and Talking With Your Doctor or Health Care Provider. These resources explain health topics, summarize research, and help patients prepare questions for clinicians rather than recommending a single commercial product or treatment.
